scientific.claim: Let \(A=A^{\mathsf T}>0\) be a Stieltjes matrix, \(D=\operatorname{diag}(A)\), \(b\ge0\), and start weighted Jacobi from \(x^{(0)}=0\): \[x^{(k+1)}=x^{(k)}+\omega D^{-1}(b-Ax^{(k)}).\] Assume the iteration converges, equivalently \(0<\omega<2/\lambda_{\max}(D^{-1/2}AD^{-1/2})\). Then \(x^{(1)}\ge0\) and \(x^{(2)}\ge0\) for every such system, and the third iterate is nonnegative for every such system and every \(b\ge0\) if and only if \(0<\omega\le3/2\). Thus \(3/2\) is the sharp universal third-iterate positivity frontier. Moreover, iteration three and dimension two are jointly minimal for positivity loss: every convergent one-dimensional weighted-Jacobi orbit from zero stays nonnegative, while for every \(3/2<\omega<2\) there is a convergent two-dimensional SPD Stieltjes system with \(b\ge0\) whose third iterate has a negative component. A concrete witness is \(\omega=8/5\), \(A=\begin{pmatrix}1&-1/5\\-1/5&1\end{pmatrix}\), and \(b=(0,1)^{\mathsf T}\), for which \(x^{(1)}=(0,8/5)^{\mathsf T}\), \(x^{(2)}=(64/125,16/25)^{\mathsf T}\), and \(x^{(3)}=(-64/625,4312/3125)^{\mathsf T}\), even though the iteration converges and \(A^{-1}b=(5/24,25/24)^{\mathsf T}>0\).
scientific.integrity: The universal statement is proved algebraically after diagonal normalization. Exact-rational replay verifies the explicit sharp witness; finite computation is not used as a substitute for the universal proof.
scientific.limitations: Fixed-weight weighted Jacobi from zero on real SPD Stieltjes systems; the theorem classifies only the first three iterates universally and does not assert all-step positivity at the threshold.

title: Three halves is the sharp third-iterate positivity frontier for convergent weighted Jacobi
